# MGA-resource · mainly-for-agent

Free, bilingual, reusable medical illustration components. No sign-in.

- [Agent guide](https://mga-resource-mainly-for-agent.pages.dev/agent)
- [OpenAPI](https://mga-resource-mainly-for-agent.pages.dev/openapi.json)
- [Categories, sources, and exact filter values](https://mga-resource-mainly-for-agent.pages.dev/catalog-info.json)
- [Version](https://mga-resource-mainly-for-agent.pages.dev/version.json)
- [Runnable Node example](https://mga-resource-mainly-for-agent.pages.dev/agent-example.mjs)

Use GET or POST /v1/search with q/query. Use /v1/browse with no query, filters.category, or unclassified=true.
POST JSON supports filters, preferences, limit (1–20), mode (explore/design/exact), seed, project, history, cursor, and response_profile (full/compact).
Read query_plan, inspect results[].preview.url, retrieve results[].download.url and verify download.sha256. Keep selected_source.provenance. metadata_url points to the matching family; do not substitute its first variant for the returned result.
Keep a stable seed per project; change rounds for exploration. Use project.style in design mode and project.selected for exact file pins. history.adopted must contain explicit final uses only (status=adopted). Next page: pass cursor=next_cursor with the same effective search and project inputs.
200 with [] means no match. 400 means invalid request or cursor. 503 means temporary unavailability; honor Retry-After. All static files have direct URLs; the three large GitHub Release originals may not support browser CORS.
Unknown label evidence remains unknown. Edit a working copy only; protect scientific arrows, scale and attribution. No library-wide text cleanup or drawing-skill automation is included.
